title: She Notices
style: 2020s synthpop, plain corporate delivery, female vocals, midtempo straight pulse, clipped analog bass, cool glassy synth chords, restrained electronic percussion, clean office-bright mix, emotionally neutral close female lead, concise verse-chorus structure with subtle chorus lift and a dry, matter-of-fact finish
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The Melgar villa has four bedrooms
Inside a gated condominium
Gabriel and Francine have the master
Lucy keeps the room she knows
Thomas and Gabi take the guest room
The fifth room changes use
Storage, guests, a small studio
Whatever fits that year

[Chorus]
For New Year, the rooms are settled
Two arrangements stand their ground
Lucía and Alicia share a bedroom
Gabriel and Francine are in theirs
Everyone else finds where to sleep
No one makes a formal plan
Sylvia sees the extra bed
And understands

[Verse 2]
Esteban stays with mother and sister
Pilar chooses distance for her work
She sees the studio, second guest room
And leaves it as it is
Lucy has her usual bedroom
Sylvia gets a mattress there
Lucy sleeps in her own bed
The plan seems simple enough

[Chorus]
For New Year, the rooms are settled
Two arrangements stand their ground
Lucía and Alicia share a bedroom
Gabriel and Francine are in theirs
Everyone else finds where to sleep
No one makes a formal plan
Sylvia sees the extra bed
And understands

[Verse 3]
On New Year's Day, Francine's sister arrives
Lucy gives her the bed
One more mattress would crowd the room
The older couple could take Sylvia
But that would feel a little strange
Thomas and Gabi could make space
But then the family might notice
More than they need to know

[Bridge]
Lucía's room has a proper spare bed
Sylvia is close in age to Esteban
A few years ahead of Alicia
Nearly grown, but still a child
When Sylvia joins the family visits
She tends to stay near Thomas's kids
No one has to explain the choice
It fits the shape already there

[Final Chorus]
For New Year, the rooms are settled
Two arrangements stand their ground
Lucía and Alicia share a bedroom
Sylvia takes the extra bed
Everyone else finds where to sleep
No one makes a formal plan
She knows why it feels so natural
And still, she notices

[Outro]
She notices
The room is quiet
She notices
